memories.title: I'm Still Figuring Out How to Explain Meta Hactong
memories.story:
Do you know about my account, Meta Hactong, that I'm doing? Because honestly, I'm still figuring out how to explain it properly.

It's consuming a lot of time to make it, and when I try to speak about it, I usually get a bit scattered. I just want the final output to come out right, that's what I'm working on.

This morning, I followed that first forty-five minutes thing. Coffee first, no screen, and I wrote down three honest lines on paper before anything digital.

That helped me say it a little clearer. If there's a problem with the other videos, just tell me. I'm still working it out.
